messages:
Alice Nguyen: Pager came in — inference-us-west showing sustained 5xx spike starting ~2026-03-15T18:02:11Z. svc=redwood-runtime, hostpool=hostpool-3. Seeing ~75-85% request failures. Putting this here to coordinate. Anyone oncall?

IncidentBot: AUTOMATED ALERT: Incident INC-2026-114 created by pager (severity: sev2). Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/inference-5xx. Notify: #incidents, @oncall-sre.

Bob Patel: I'm oncall, taking it. Checking logs and recent deploys. Alice — any deploys in the last 30m?

Alice Nguyen: No deploys from infra/eng in the last 45m. Autoscaler bumped some pods ~11:00 for burst traffic. I can pull proxy logs and LB traces now.

Bob Patel: grabbing runtime logs and health checks. quick check: `curl -sS https://runtime-us-west/health | jq .` returning 200 but `/generate` returns 500. tailing pod logs:
```
2026-03-15T18:01:53Z error runtime: kernel schedule: kvcache misalign
2026-03-15T18:02:02Z error handler: downstream transport: write ECONNRESET
2026-03-15T18:02:05Z error model: failed to allocate tensor buffer
```

Bob Patel: Looks like memory pressure / allocation failures in hostpool-3 g4 instances. Scaling hostpool live to add capacity, and I'll set routing to prefer hostpool-1/2.

Eve Thompson: Re-routing now via router-config: `route: pref(hostpool-1,hostpool-2) fallback hostpool-3` — applied. I'll monitor error rate.

Alice Nguyen: Monitoring shows error rate dropped from 80% -> 12% within 90s after reroute. Good. But we need root cause and keep evidence. Carol /sec — can you confirm audit logs for hostpool-3 between 18:00-18:10? We need to preserve for compliance.

Carol Martinez: Noted. Quick heads-up: I'm seeing incomplete audit log entries for the compute nodes in hostpool-3 during that exact window (some entries missing request IDs). Suspect a logging agent crash or IAM policy revocation. We need to snapshot disks and export the journal/syslog before we tear anything down.

Bob Patel: Ok — do not reboot or scale down hostpool-3 nodes until snapshots taken. I'm going to isolate one affected instance for forensics and start a full journal export. Commands I will run: 
```
sudo journalctl --since "2026-03-15 18:00:00" --until "2026-03-15 18:15:00" -o json > /tmp/journal-export.json
sudo tar -czf /tmp/hostpool3-nodeA-logs.tgz /var/log /tmp/journal-export.json
gcloud compute disks snapshot nodeA-disk --zone=us-west1-b --snapshot-names=hostpool3-nodeA-20260315
```

Carol Martinez: I'll fetch GCP audit logs for the window with this filter:
```
resource.type="gce_instance" AND timestamp>="2026-03-15T18:00:00Z" AND timestamp<="2026-03-15T18:15:00Z" AND protoPayload.methodName:("v1.compute.instances.attachDisk" OR "v1.compute.instances.setMetadata" OR "logging.googleapis.com")
```
Also enabling export to secure-bucket `s3://redwood-audit-archive-temp` (access restricted) for immutable copy.

Bob Patel: IncidentBot — marking mitigation: routing change + scale-up.

IncidentBot: MITIGATION NOTE recorded on INC-2026-114: traffic reroute to hostpool-1/2, hostpool-3 isolated and snapshot scheduled.

Alice Nguyen: Customers impacted — we saw a spike in 500s for Teams A/B (ids: acct-94, acct-122) for ~3m. CS notified and ticketed. Adding link: https://support/alerts/INC-2026-114-customer-impact

PM Dana: Copy. Please include a short customer-impact blurb for postmortem: "Transient 500s for inference requests in us-west; ~3 minutes of elevated errors affecting a small percentage of requests; degraded throughput for hostpool-3 were mitigated by automatic routing."

Carol Martinez: Quick security note: audit gap is concerning. If logging agent crashed, we may be missing some auth/elev actions; collect MD5 of binaries and preserve `/etc/` and `/var/lib/google-logging` dirs.

Bob Patel: Acknowledged. I have copied artifacts to secure bucket: `gs://redwood-forensics/INC-2026-114/` — journal, tarball, disk-snapshot-id: hostpool3-nodeA-20260315. Leaving node in quarantine mode.

Eve Thompson: Error rate stabilized at <1% on all regions. Rolling back hostpool-3 to drained state until further notice.

Bob Patel: I'm going to run the logging agent on a non-production host with verbose flags to reproduce crash: `gce-logging-agent --verbose --dry-run` then replicate. Will create a reproducible debug burndown and post findings.

Carol Martinez: For compliance ticketing: we need chain-of-custody notes. Bob — please add the export commands, checksums, and who touched the artifacts to the audit log entry. I will attach the GCP export and the IAM policy snapshot.

Bob Patel: Added chain-of-custody notes to the bucket metadata and to INC-2026-114.

PM Dana: We should schedule a postmortem. How about tomorrow 10:00 PT? Attendees: SRE, Eng Runtime, Security, PM, CS.

Alice Nguyen: Tomorrow 10:00 PT works for eng-runtime. I'll create the doc. Draft link: https://docs.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-114 (will fill with timeline, impact, RCA, action items).

Dan Li: I can take the follow-on oncall for overnight. Handoff: Bob — anything I need to watch?

Bob Patel: Dan — nothing urgent. Hostpool-3 is drained/quarantined; we have snapshots in `gs://redwood-forensics/INC-2026-114/`. Watch for residual errors and any alerts for logging export failures. I'll add runbook step to avoid autoscaler rapidly re-adding nodes to that pool.

IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status -> mitigated. Root cause analysis pending.

Carol Martinez: Action items for security/compliance (quick list):
- Collect and archive audit exports for 17:50-18:20 window (Carol) — DONE (gs://redwood-audit-archive-temp/INC-2026-114)
- Snapshot affected node disks and export checksums (Bob) — DONE hostpool3-nodeA-20260315 sha256:abc123...
- Add guardrails to logging agent (Eng Runtime) — Owner: Alice Nguyen, ETA: 2026-03-22
- Add automated verification that audit exports completed post-incident (Security/Infra) — Owner: Carol Martinez, ETA: 2026-03-30
- Update runbook to explicitly pause autoscaler for quarantined hostpools (Eng-SRE) — Owner: Dan Li, ETA: 2026-03-18

PM Dana: I'll track those in the remediation board: https://tracker.company/incidents/INC-2026-114 and assign Jira EPIC INC-2026-114-REM.

Eve Thompson: Quick follow-up: add a monitoring alert that detects "logging agent restart > 1 in 5m" per node. I can add that rule.

Alice Nguyen: For the postmortem please include the timeline (attached logs), mitigation steps, and the audit gap appendix. Security — can you add a short note about evidence sufficiency for compliance?

Carol Martinez: Will add evidence note to the postmortem doc. Preliminary assessment: sufficient artifacts captured to satisfy internal audit, but we need to formalize immutable export to an archived store to avoid future gaps.

Bob Patel: I'll draft the RCA section: suspected cause = logging agent OOM leading to partial audit loss; contributing factor = autoscaler adding nodes simultaneously causing memory pressure and transient allocation failures.

Dan Li: I'll take the runbook update PR after the postmortem.

Alice Nguyen: Postmortem scheduled: 2026-03-16 10:00 PT — invite sent to attendees. Action items and owners listed in tracker. Closing thread for real-time incident coordination. Please add anything I missed. :thumbsup:

IncidentBot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: INC-2026-114 marked resolved at 2026-03-15T19:05:12Z. Postmortem scheduled 2026-03-16 17:00 UTC.
